# ssp_alarm_counts (Data Source)

Retrieves alarm instance counts by lifecycle state, grouped by category and severity.

Corresponds to `POST /ssp/alarms/counts`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `feature_names` (List of String) Filter counts to these feature names.

### Read-Only

- `acknowledged_instance_counts` (Attributes List) Instance counts grouped by category and severity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acknowledged_instance_counts))
- `open_instance_counts` (Attributes List) Instance counts grouped by category and severity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_instance_counts))
- `resolved_instance_counts` (Attributes List) Instance counts grouped by category and severity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resolved_instance_counts))
- `suppressed_instance_counts` (Attributes List) Instance counts grouped by category and severity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--suppressed_instance_counts))
- `total_instance_count` (Number) Total count of alarm instances found across all pages.

<a id="nestedatt--acknowledged_instance_counts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `acknowledged_instance_counts`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category name (typically a feature name).
- `counts` (Attributes List) Per-severity counts within this category. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acknowledged_instance_counts--counts))
